## Golden Wheat — Crystal Empire helper

Golden Wheat is a pale cream-colored Crystal Empire Earth-pony mare with a light golden mane and tail, blue-gray eyes, and a golden wheat-stalk cutie mark. She is easiest to recognize as one of the residents helping tidy the city before the Equestria Games. Her design overlaps with other Crystal Ponies, especially Autumn Gem and Sapphire Joy; those are similar-looking characters, not verified alter egos. [Crystal Pony character roster](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Crystal_Ponies).

**Name and voice.** She is not named in dialogue. *Golden Wheat* is a name established in licensed Enterplay merchandise: the 2014 *Crystal Games* collectible card **#84 C, “Golden Wheat, Happy to Help.”** The card depicts her as a helpful caretaker; its animal-care background is card lore rather than an independently shown episode scene. No individual speaking line or voice actor is verified. [Card identification and release](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/card/golden-wheat%2C-happy-to-help/).

## Important moments

1. **Among the Crystal Empire's returning residents** — *The Crystal Empire – Part 1* (S3E1). She walks alongside Autumn Gem in the newly returned kingdom, establishing her as a local resident rather than a named participant in the main plot. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v4gv7fvKcE4) — scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **Pitching in for the Games** — *Games Ponies Play* (S3E12). She is shown scrubbing and cleaning the city before the Equestria Games inspection, her clearest identifiable on-screen action. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P8y5qYYbMMY) — scene timestamp unavailable.

These are brief background appearances, not dialogue-driven or plot-changing hero moments.
